messages.author: cda83847cc488c80
messages.subject: Problems with downloading rattle and R 3.0.1
parts:
Hi Guys…..

 

I don’t know if the issue has been dealt with… but I am having problems downloading rattle onto 3.0.1. I have just purchased a new computer, and on this computer upgrades R to 3.0.1. It seems to download rattle ok… but when I want to load rattle,  I get the following promising message:

 

Rattle: A free graphical interface for data mining with R.

Version 2.6.26 r77 Copyright (c) 2006-2013 Togaware Pty Ltd.

Type 'rattle()' to shake, rattle, and roll your data.

 

But alas… no rattle begins….

 

Am I doing something wrong?????

 

Cheers

 

John
